name: carnot_engine
engine: Carnot cycle, monatomic ideal gas working substance

jax.reason: BASE ENGINE: classical ideal-gas P-V thermodynamics on jax.numpy x64 -- numeric trapezoid integration of P(V) along each stroke, closed-loop area cross-check, and root-level arithmetic. The independent jax leg (carnot_engine_jax.py) recomputes the headline scalars and adds a diffrax Lindblad thermal-contact cross-check; the three_engine_seal re-runs that leg to re-derive.

julia.reason: Authoritative independent leg (carnot_engine_julia.jl): Julia trapezoid recompute of eta/W_net plus a QuantumOptics timeevolution.master detailed-balance relaxation to the Gibbs populations at Th and Tc (thermal-contact premise). Reference on disagreement.

diffrax.reason: In the jax leg only: ODETerm+Dopri5+PIDController detailed-balance Lindblad relaxation, cross-checked against the closed-form Gibbs approach (pattern proven in sim_engines/stress/diffrax_lindblad_cycle_probe.py). Supportive: grounds the isothermal-stroke premise; the cycle itself is quasi-static and needs no time solver.

qutip.reason: no Hilbert space / operator content in the classical ideal gas cycle itself; importing qutip here would be decorative, not load-bearing, so it is honestly left unused. The quantum thermal-contact cross-checks run in the engine legs (dynamiqs-family diffrax / QuantumOptics) instead.

C4_degenerate_Th_eq_Tc_zero_work_control.note: Carnot engine across zero temperature difference must admit zero net work -- this is the negative control paired against the positive eta=1-Tc/Th claim.

r_sweep_eta_invariance.note: eta must be independent of the isothermal expansion ratio r=V2/V1 by construction; this sweep is the boundary check that this invariance actually holds numerically, not just algebraically.

C5_cross_engine_agreement.note: julia (QuantumOptics thermal contact + Julia trapezoid) and jax (diffrax thermal contact + jnp trapezoid) each recompute eta and W_net independently; values must be consistent with each other and with the base jnp cycle. Julia is the reference on disagreement.

thermal_contact_cross_check.note: detailed-balance Lindblad relaxation to the Gibbs populations at Th and Tc, per leg -- the isothermal-stroke bath-contact premise run as actual dynamics, consistent with the closed form in both engines.

promotion_condition: not applicable -- this is a tool/engine competence check, not a Codex-Ratchet lego/bridge/axis admission attempt
out_of_scope: no lego promotion from this result
no bridge, axis, engine-estate, emergence, or nonclassical claim

engine_machinery_used.note: the cycle itself is classical ideal-gas P-V thermodynamics on jax.numpy x64 (quasi-static -- no time solver needed); the bath-contact premise is grounded by Lindblad relaxation in both engine legs (diffrax / QuantumOptics), where quantum machinery genuinely applies.
